modules.purpose:
Package auth is a kept (non-example) module: concrete users schema, JWT
signup/login, email verification and password reset, backed by sqlc queries.
modules.summary: Package auth is a kept (non-example) module: concrete users schema, JWT signup/login, email verification and password reset, backed by sqlc queries.

modules.purpose: Package cache provides the Redis client used for request-time caching.
modules.summary: Package cache provides the Redis client used for request-time caching.

modules.purpose:
Command workers runs background jobs. It currently hosts the transactional
outbox relay: it publishes unpublished `outbox` rows to Kafka/Redpanda for
at-least-once delivery, then marks them published.

Domain code enqueues events with the EnqueueOutbox query in the SAME database
transaction as the domain change; this relay delivers them out-of-band.
Package config loads runtime configuration from a YAML file with env overrides.
modules.summary: Package config loads runtime configuration from a YAML file with env overrides.

modules.purpose:
Package events publishes domain events to Kafka/Redpanda. Services call
Publisher.Publish; swap in the transactional outbox pattern for at-least-once
delivery (see TEMPLATE_NOTES.md).
modules.summary: Package events publishes domain events to Kafka/Redpanda.

modules.purpose:
Package health implements the always-present liveness probe. Like the items
example, it demonstrates the full vertical slice: OpenAPI spec ->
oapi-codegen (gin-server interface) -> handler. Unlike items it has no
store/db dependency and is always registered, regardless of auth or
include_example_domain, so a freshly generated project always shows the
codegen pipeline end to end.
modules.summary: Package health implements the always-present liveness probe.

modules.purpose:
Package items is the disposable EXAMPLE domain. It demonstrates the full
vertical slice: OpenAPI spec -> oapi-codegen (gin-server interface) -> handler
-> sqlc-generated store -> postgres. Copy this pattern for real domains, then
delete this package (see TEMPLATE_NOTES.md).
modules.summary: Package items is the disposable EXAMPLE domain.

modules.purpose:
Package mail renders and delivers transactional emails (verification and
password reset).

SECURITY: credentials (verification tokens, reset
tokens) are delivered here — they are NEVER returned in API
responses. The transport is selected at runtime from MailConfig.Provider;
an unknown/empty provider falls back to the log transport, which prints the
message to the server log so credentials stay observable in development.
modules.summary: Package mail renders and delivers transactional emails (verification and password reset).

modules.purpose:
Package migrate applies goose SQL migrations at startup. It is a runtime
concern kept separate from internal/database, which holds only sqlc-generated
query code.
modules.summary: Package migrate applies goose SQL migrations at startup.

modules.purpose:
Package observability wires OpenTelemetry tracing. By default (no endpoint) it
installs nothing, so the global tracer stays a no-op and the app runs with no
external dependencies. Point config.Observability.Endpoint at an OTLP/gRPC
collector (host:port) to export traces; otelgin and otelpgx then light up.

Package payments wraps the Razorpay client. This is an integration point:
add order creation, webhook verification, and subscription handling for your
product (see TEMPLATE_NOTES.md).
modules.summary: Package payments wraps the Razorpay client.

modules.purpose:
Package push sends push notifications via Firebase Cloud Messaging. This is an
integration point: build your notification payloads on top of Send.
modules.summary: Package push sends push notifications via Firebase Cloud Messaging.

modules.purpose:
Package ratelimit implements token-bucket rate limiting (Redis-backed via
GCRA) declared per-operation through the OpenAPI `x-rate-limit` vendor
extension, plus a separately-gated global per-IP floor. See CONTEXT.md and
docs/adr/0001-redis-and-rate-limiting-are-unconditional-infra.md for the design.
modules.summary: Package ratelimit implements token-bucket rate limiting (Redis-backed via GCRA) declared per-operation through the OpenAPI `x-rate-limit` vendor extension, plus a separately-gated global per-IP floor.

modules.purpose:
Package server wires config, observability, the database pool and the HTTP
router together. New domains register their routes in Run().
modules.summary: Package server wires config, observability, the database pool and the HTTP router together.

modules.purpose:
Package storage wraps an S3-compatible object store. This is an integration
point: use PresignPut/PresignGet to hand clients time-limited upload/download
URLs. Follow the ownership-prefix convention (users/<id>/..., etc.).
modules.summary: Package storage wraps an S3-compatible object store.

modules.purpose:
Package testsupport provides shared helpers for integration-style handler
tests: a connection to the test database (docker/docker-compose-test.yaml),
migrations, and per-test truncation. Tests register real routes on a real
gin router and hit real endpoint paths.

Each test package gets its OWN postgres schema (via search_path), so packages
run in parallel without colliding. Pass a unique schema name from TestMain.
modules.summary: Package testsupport provides shared helpers for integration-style handler tests: a connection to the test database (docker/docker-compose-test.yaml), migrations, and per-test truncation.
